notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.7
notes.notes:
- Brought movement rules in line with full game rules. If a unit moves into a space occupied by another unit, the displaced unit is moved to the reserves space and can take a free move that turn. Free moves are shown next to the remaining moves at the top of the screen in brackets, and in the reserves window the unit is clearly marked as having a free move available.

- Again in line with full game rules the game ends after the final Soviet action phase (not the Wehrmacht card phase as per the previous version). Then if possible the Milk Run Storm Group will take place.

- Fixed a bug where in specific circumstances it was possible to apply reinforcements during the move phase.

notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.6
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the movement phase wasn't ending properly
- Fixed an issue where sapper token images weren't being removed at the end of the game

notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Fixed issue where FoW cards were being generated incorrectly.
Fixed issue where cancelling resupply cleared out the supply entirely.
Fixed a couple of typos.

notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug which was allowing reinforcements during the movement phase
- Upgraded the Unity engine version

notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.3
notes.notes:
- Extended the card helper settings option to provide continual help for both cards and unit actions (now renamed Action Helper).
- Added sniper results text to the latest report box
- Fixed a couple of minor typos in the tutorial
- Fixed an issue where operations cards weren't scoring (this issues was in the 1.0.2 release).
- Improved the text accompanying the Storm Group card to explain how the card is resolved

notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.2 Release
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has provided feedback since the Pavlov's House release. Please find the 1.0.2 changelog below.

- Added a fullscreen/windowed option (Windows only for now)
- Added some helper text for Storm Group cards and Operations cards (click on the card for the help)
- Added some helper text in the Forward Observer unit window
- Added a cancel button while supplies are being loaded onto the Volga
- Added tooltips on unit status tokens (exhausted, disrupted, etc)
- Fixed a bug where the card help wasn't appearing even if it was set to in the settings
- Fixed a bug where pressing fog of war left the card option behind at the end of the turn
- Fixed a couple of bugs where tool tips turned up on cards when they weren't visible
- Corrected the costs shown on some of the large Soviet unit images
- Made the Forward Observer fire button dependent on having at least one target set and artillery selected.

notes.title: Pavlov's House 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The following changes are in release 1.0.1. Thanks to everyone who provided feedback. Other requested changes will hopefully go into release 1.0.2.

- Fixed the framerate to 60FPS
- Added tooltips to the first aid, food, sapper and ammo tokens
- Fixed a couple of typos in the tooltips and tutorial
- Improved a couple of the explanations in the tutorial
- A minor tidy to some of the instrumentation in the music
- Fixed a couple of unit tokens showing the incorrect cost
